title: 2D assembled ZnO/ZnCo2O4 heterostructures as efficient electrocatalysts for electrochemical detection of ofloxacin in water: experimental and DFT study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1368-1381
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08937A, Paper

This work presents a rapid synthesis of ZnO/ZnCo2O4 heterojunctions with unique two dimensional (2D) nanostructure for the enhancement of electrochemical sensing of ofloxacin in water.
